messages:
alex.ops: Heads-up: we're getting elevated 5xx and tail latency for hosted generation requests routed through US-EAST1. Customers reporting slow responses and intermittent failures. Paging SRE + Infra. https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2959991234

sre-oncall: Acknowledged. Seeing p50/p95 spike for /v1/generate in us-east1-router cluster. Error rate ~9% 5xx, p95 latency ~1.8s (baseline 200ms). Starting targeted traffic draining away from affected router pool.

infra-bot: Route shift initiated: rerouting 40% of us-east1-gen traffic to us-central and us-west edge clusters. Command: `route shift --region us-east1 --pct 40 --targets us-central,us-west`

mina.eng: Investigating recent kernel upgrade on us-east1-router nodes; rolled back one kernel patch on node us-east1-router-7 due to reported iowait regressions. Also checking our connection pool and muxer for head-of-line stalls.

sre-oncall: After partial route shift and kernel rollback, 5xx down to ~3.2% and p95 at ~650ms. Still elevated. Observed many small clients getting retried quickly leading to bursty backend load.

josh.cs: Support has queued affected customers who reported timeouts. Starting customer outreach for larger impacted accounts and adding mitigation suggestions (retry/backoff + using us-central region).

mina.eng: Found a goroutine leak in router muxer that increases memory and slows accept loops under high concurrency. I pushed a hotfix to reduce connection churn (PR #5012) and restarted router pool gradually in us-east1.

infra-bot: Deploy of PR #5012 to us-east1-router pool: `deploy apply router-mux-fix 2026-03-24T14:10Z`

sre-oncall: Post-deploy: error rate ~1.1%, p95 ~230ms. Observing stabilizing metrics. Continuing to monitor for any regression.

status-bot: STATUS PAGE UPDATED by alex.ops -> https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2959991234 (impact: Degraded performance for generation requests via us-east1; mitigations: traffic reroute, kernel rollback, router muxer hotfix).

alex.ops: Current impact: Hosted API generation requests routed through us-east1 may experience elevated latency and transient 5xxs. Dedicated/Private not affected. Next update in 30m or earlier. Postmortem owner: mina.eng. ETA for postmortem draft: EOD 2026-03-25. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

josh.cs: Drafted customer note referencing status page and recommending regional endpoint override for critical flows. Will send after final confirmation that errors remain <2%.

mina.eng: Follow-up ticket filed to add health-based connection pool trimming and integration tests for muxer concurrency: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-7420

alex.ops: Closing active alert channel, moving to monitoring mode. If you see a regression, ping @sre-oncall. :white_check_mark:
